summary: IR-camera + Z-piezo PI feedback. Required for the FocusLock widget.

fields.label: Detector
fields.tip: Detector used for the focus-lock IR spot. The detector should have forFocusLock=true.

fields.label: Z Positioner
fields.tip: Z positioner used to apply focus corrections.

fields.label: Update freq (Hz)
fields.tip: Focus-estimate update rate in hertz: the camera is read and the correction computed this many times per second. Must be positive; rates above 1000 Hz are floored to a 1 ms timer.

fields.label: Crop X
fields.tip: Starting X position of camera frame crop.

fields.label: Crop Y
fields.tip: Starting Y position of camera frame crop.

fields.label: Swap image axes
fields.tip: Transpose the camera frame before locating the spot.

fields.label: PI Kp
fields.tip: Proportional gain of the feedback loop.

fields.label: PI Ki
fields.tip: Integral gain of the feedback loop.
